name: GetHotelSpecialDeals
description: Gets current special deals and offers available for Octank hotels

name: GetAvailableRooms
description: Gets available hotel rooms for a specific Octank hotel location, date and guest count. The hotel location options are Chicago, San Francisco, or London.

location.description: Hotel location. Must be one of: Chicago, San Francisco, or London

date.description: Date to check availability in YYYY-MM-DD format

guests.description: Number of guests (1-8). Defaults to 2 if not specified

name: BookHotelRoom
description: Book a hotel room at one of the Octank hotel locations (Chicago, San Francisco, or London) for specific check-in date, check-out date, number of guests, and room type.

location.description: Hotel location. Must be one of: Chicago, San Francisco, or London

NumberOfGuests.description: Number of guests for the reservation

roomType.description: Type of room to book (e.g., Standard, Deluxe, Suite)

name: SearchHotelKnowledgeBase
description: Search the Octank Hotels knowledge base for information about hotel amenities, policies, FAQs, services, and general hotel information for Chicago, San Francisco, and London locations.

query.description: The search query about hotel information, amenities, policies, or services
